_note: Copy this, fill it in from your own provider account, and point FLYTHROUGH_PROVIDER at the copy. The TOKEN does not go in here -- it goes in FLYTHROUGH_PROVIDER_TOKEN, so a profile can be committed, diffed and code-reviewed without a credential in it. Every value below is read from the provider's own API documentation; none of it is guessed on your behalf, because a wrong endpoint fails only once real money is behind it.
